unresolved: Five-cat retrospective case series; patients are numbered by Table 1 row order because the abstract describes the cats only as a cohort and the first individual identity evidence is the Table 1 rows.

Cohort statements (3/5 cats asymptomatic, one cat well-controlled diabetic and hyperthyroid, 3/5 alive, one euthanized for unrelated causes, mean survival 878.5 days, enzyme means and ranges) are not copied to individual cats unless a labelled sentence supports them.
The results text gives the ALT range as 27–211 U/l whereas Table 2 lists 2111 for cat 2; recorded as an ambiguity, the table cell is kept as printed.

Table 2 bold cells are literal <bold> markup in the source XML, defined by the footnote as outside the reference interval. High flags are set only where the cat's own text or Table 1 row states the enzymes are increased (cats 1, 2, 3 and 5 enzymes); bold total bilirubin cells keep flag unknown because no direction is stated; cat 4 enzymes are flagged normal from its text. No flag is derived from the reference intervals.

Figures 1 to 3 are line charts with no printed data values; plotted points are visual estimates and are not recorded as facts. The plotted day 0 AST for cat 5 looks far below the Table 2 value of 102 U/l, and plotted values are not reconciled with the table.
Table images (Tables 1 to 3) are uncaptioned unwrapped graphics whose content duplicates the source table rows; their ownership is not resolved from the image itself.
Caption-layer visual status not_inspected; the actual image pixels were inspected in the separate visual target.
The source lists one unassigned inline image; the XML places it in the ORCID iD footnote, so it is treated as non-clinical. It was not viewed and is not part of the visual target.

ALT range 27-211 vs Table 2 2111: cohort statistic, mean 749.8 confirms 2111; kept as ambiguity, not a per-cat conflict.
